items.description: Each logical figure, including an HTML widget and static-twin pair, has a prose paragraph before the outer figure or format gate.
The introduction is one substantive paragraph rather than a heading, list, comment, callout fence, or multi-paragraph digression.
The introduction passes the current STYLE.md hard rules and style linter.
The introduction states what the figure shows and why it matters at this point in the argument.
A registered widget has an equivalent static print figure; the two are counted as one logical figure.
